title: Observability: ioctl_gen_iv gen_iv() failure has no log message
description: In ioctl_gen_iv, if ops->gen_iv() returns non-zero the code does 'goto out_zeroize' with no log message. The provider may or may not log internally (wolfssl_aes_cbc_gen_iv calls wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err but has no pr_err before return). A GEN_IV failure is silent in the fd.c layer — a support engineer sees -EACCES (or whatever xlat returns) from the ioctl with nothing in dmesg to indicate which algo/provider/wolfCrypt code produced it. Fix: add pr_err_ratelimited at the gen_iv() failure site, consistent with set_iv() which does log.
